  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":448,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"''\", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;","note":"A leading triple-quote sequence diverts lexing into multiline-string mode."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":338,"var":"end","code":"char *end = (peek(lexer) == '\"') ? \"\"\"\" : \"'''\";","note":"The lexer chooses the closing delimiter for the multiline string it is about to scan."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":343,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) { emit(lexer, LEXEME_STRING); lexer->pos += 3; return lex_config; }","note":"The loop reads through the input until it finds the terminator; on a short malformed input it can advance past the mapped end and perform an out-of-bounds read."}
]
